dek: Combioh teaches Nioh 3 combos. Pick a style, weapons and a difficulty, and a custom controller tool shows each combo's inputs mapped to your own controller configuration, as button sequences timed to the move, in five languages.
short: A Nioh 3 combo trainer: pick a style, weapons and a difficulty, and a custom controller UI shows each combo on your own button layout as timed sequences, in five languages, with every choice shareable from the URL.

facts.label: Data
facts.value: One JSON file of authored combos

highlights.title: Your controller, your inputs
highlights.text: A custom controller UI maps every combo to the player's own button configuration, so the glyphs on screen match the pad in their hands.

highlights.title: Timed sequences
highlights.text: Button sequences play back on the combo's own timing, so players learn the rhythm, not just the order.

highlights.title: State in the URL
highlights.text: Class, weapons, difficulty and controller layout persist in the URL, so a combo can be shared as a link.

highlights.title: Flags are not languages
highlights.text: Chinese support arrived on May 24. An October 14 commit replaced flag icons with language names.
